by
  intro X
  apply CategoryTheory.Epi.ofSurjective
  intros Y g h
  rcases CategoryTheory.Epi.eq_of_comp_eq_id f (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id M₂) (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id M₂) with ⟨g, h⟩
  obtain ⟨g', h'⟩ := h
  apply_fun (λ (g : M₂.obj X ⟶ M₁.obj X), g) at h'
  apply_fun (λ (g : M₂.obj X ⟶ M₁.obj X), g) at h
  exact h'
